title: Transport the official exterior tensor quotient to exteriorSheaf
statement: For a scheme X, sheaves of modules A,B,C, an epimorphism g:B→C, and natural numbers r,s, the canonical comparison of exteriorSheaf with the official exteriorPower transports the official tensor exterior quotient to an epimorphism q:exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf B s → exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf C s. On every open U it sends the tensor of wedge sections from tuples a,c to the tensor of wedge sections from a and g(c), including r=0 or s=0.

proof.text: Apply the official exteriorTensor_quotient_exists to obtain q with its epimorphy and pure-wedge formula. Let eAB and eAC be the tensors of the canonical exteriorSheafPowerIso comparisons, and define the transported map eAB.hom ≫ q ≫ eAC.inv. It is epi since q is epi and the comparisons are isomorphisms.

The inverse tensor comparisons take official wedge tensors to tensors of exteriorSheafSection, by tensorHom_app_tmulSection and exteriorSheafPowerIso_inv_wedge. The equality eAB.inv ≫ transported q = q ≫ eAC.inv follows by cancelling the comparison isomorphism. Evaluate it on the official wedge tensor; substitute the inverse comparison formulas and the official quotient formula. This proves exactly the claimed section formula, without any additional assumptions. Degree-zero tuples, empty opens, the empty scheme and zero rings require no special case.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheafTensor_quotient_exists {X : Scheme.{v}} (A B C : X.Modules)
    (g : B ⟶ C) [Epi g] (r s : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf B s ⟶
        exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf C s,
      Epi q ∧ ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
        (c : Fin s → B.val.obj (op U)),
        q.val.app (op U)
            (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a) (exteriorSheafSection B s U c)) =
          tmulSection (M := exteriorSheaf A r) (N := exteriorSheaf C s)
            (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection C s U (fun i ↦ g.val.app (op U) (c i)))
